step1.title: Welcome to Praxi-Bot
step1.subtitle: Your personal, local-first computer-use assistant. Let’s get you set up in a couple of minutes — no terminal required.
step1.languageHint: You can switch between English and Turkish at any time.
step1.themeHint: Pick light, dark, or follow your Windows system theme.
step1.privacyBody: Your chats, permissions, and bot profiles stay on your computer. Praxi-Bot collects no telemetry or analytics; data is sent only to the model provider you configure.

step2.title: Connect a model provider
step2.subtitle: Pick where your bot’s intelligence runs. Your API key is stored in the Windows Credential Manager and is never shown again.

step3.title: Choose your safety defaults
step3.subtitle: Decide what your bot is allowed to do on this computer by default. You can change this per bot or per category at any time.
step3.whatItMeansTitle: What the bot can do on your computer

explain.read-only: The bot can inspect your screen, read files, and look at web pages, but it can never click, type, edit files, or run commands.
explain.read-and-draft: The bot can read files, search the web, and inspect your screen freely, and asks before drafting, changing or deleting files, fetching pages, clicking, typing, running commands, or sending messages (same effective policy as Approve destructive).
explain.approve-destructive: The bot can read files and inspect your screen freely, and shows you a live approval card before clicking, typing, editing files, running shell commands, or sending messages.
explain.full: The bot can read, click, type, edit or delete ordinary files, run shell commands, and send messages without asking first (except the hard safety floors below).

step3.floorMoney: Financial & payment actions always require your explicit confirmation.
step3.floorNever: Built-in never-list: credential stores, SSH/GPG private keys, and critical OS boot files are always blocked.
step3.floorHotkey: Press {{hotkey}} at any time — or click “Take the wheel” in the floating widget — to stop the bot immediately.

autonomyHints.ask: Reads files, checks the screen, and searches the web without asking; asks before drafting, sending, changing or deleting files, fetching pages, clicking, or running commands (same effective policy as Balanced).
autonomyHints.balanced: Reads files, checks the screen, and searches the web freely; asks before every file write or delete, draft, send, page fetch, click, or command (same effective policy as Ask).
autonomyHints.auto: Runs without asking—including deleting ordinary files, running shell commands, and sending messages—pausing only for Money, schedule activations, and never-list commands (disk format, system/home wipes, credential paths).
